'''Clue scroll (medium)''' is a [[cipher clue]] obtained during [[Treasure Trails]].

Traiborn's challenge clue is: ''How many air runes would I need to cast 630 wind waves?'' Each [[wind wave]] spell costs 5 [[air rune]]s and 1 [[death rune]]. The answer to this challenge can be solved with the following equation: 
<math>\text{5 x 630 = 3150}</math>
